_help: Your details for the website. Edit the text between the quotes, then run `npm run build`.
Leave "url" empty until the site is live, then set it (e.g. "https://yourname.com/") so link previews show your photo.
"facts" and "links" are lists of "Label": "value" pairs: add, remove or rename them freely.
Leave "email" empty to show only the links.
"show" sets how much location and date text from your photos' metadata the page shows:
"title" follows your name in the browser tab ("Your Name — Photography"); "language" is the page's language code.
